narrative.intro: Association of Universities for Research In Astronomy obligated $232M in FY2026 to date. Association of Universities for Research In Astronomy received 3 awards so far, with an average award size of $77.3M. Association of Universities for Research In Astronomy obligations are down 22.6% year over year. Association of Universities for Research In Astronomy work is concentrated in Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences, which accounted for $134M of obligations, and Optical Instrument and Lens Manufacturing, which accounted for $71.4M. Association of Universities for Research In Astronomy also recorded $26.2M in Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology). Association of Universities for Research In Astronomy totals are partial because current-year totals are fiscal year to date and the note clarifies that listed award-value figures in largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values rather than obligations.

sections.heading: How do FY2026 obligations compare with recent fiscal years?
sections.body: Association of Universities for Research In Astronomy obligated $232M in FY26 to date. Association of Universities for Research In Astronomy obligations have varied by year: FY21 $120M, FY22 $274M, FY23 $196M, FY24 $244M, and FY25 $299M. Association of Universities for Research In Astronomy obligations are down 22.6% year over year.
